parts.title: Part 1: 强制流程与状态检测

dialogue.en: What is the procedure followed mandatorily before we conduct any electrical maintenance?
dialogue.zh: 我们开展所有电气维保前，必须强制执行什么流程？

dialogue.en: All electrical work requires the implementation of Lockout/Tagout (L. O. T. O.) procedures. We must isolate energy sources, lock the devices, and post warning tags to prevent accidental power startup.
dialogue.zh: 所有电气作业必须执行挂牌上锁流程。彻底隔离能源、锁定开关、悬挂警示标识，杜绝意外送电。

dialogue.en: Do we need to test the equipment status before electrical operation?
dialogue.zh: 电气作业前是否需要检测设备带电状态？

dialogue.en: Yes. We must perform live-dead testing on-site. Verify live status before shutdown and confirm dead zero-energy status before LOTO to ensure safety.
dialogue.zh: 需要。现场必须执行带电-失电测试。停机前确认带电状态，挂牌上锁前核验零能量失电状态，保障作业安全。

parts.title: Part 2: 人员资质与防护装备

dialogue.en: Who are allowed to perform on-site electrical work?
dialogue.zh: 谁获准开展现场电气作业？

dialogue.en: Only qualified/certified electrical personnel can conduct electrical tasks. Untrained staff are strictly prohibited from any electrical operation.
dialogue.zh: 只有持证合格电工可开展电气作业，未受训人员严禁任何电气操作。

dialogue.en: What P. P. E. and tools are required for high voltage work?
dialogue.zh: 高压电气作业，必须配备哪些防护和工具？

dialogue.en: Workers shall use voltage-rated insulating rubber gloves with leather protectors, arc-rated flame-resistant clothing, insulating hard hat with arc flash face shield, insulating boots. We also need voltage-rated insulated hand tools, insulating blankets and insulating mats. All equipment must match the system voltage and pass periodic testing.
dialogue.zh: 作业人员要佩戴对应电压等级的绝缘橡胶手套（外加皮革保护手套）、电弧防护阻燃服、带电弧防护面屏的绝缘安全帽、绝缘靴。配套使用额定电压的绝缘手动工具、绝缘毯、绝缘垫。所有装备必须匹配系统电压，并定期检测。

parts.title: Part 3: 带电禁令与承包商管控

dialogue.en: Can our team carry out minor modifications while the equipment is live?
dialogue.zh: 设备带电状态下，我们可以做小的改动作业吗？

dialogue.en: No. Unauthorized live-line work is strictly forbidden. All adjustments and repairs must be done under complete de-energized status with LOTO implementation.
dialogue.zh: 不可以。严禁无授权带电作业，所有调试、维修工作必须完全断电、完成挂牌上锁后开展。

dialogue.en: How do we manage electrical safety for external contractors?
dialogue.zh: 外来承包商的电气安全我们该如何管控？

dialogue.en: All contractors must take electrical safety training, follow site LOTO rules, and be supervised by our internal qualified personnel during electrical work.
dialogue.zh: 所有承包商必须完成电气安全培训，严格遵守现场挂牌上锁规范，电气作业全程由我方持证人员监督。

parts.title: Part 4: 日常巡检与违规处置

dialogue.en: What daily checks should our facility team focus on?
dialogue.zh: 我们厂务团队日常电气巡检重点是什么？

dialogue.en: Inspect wire aging, loose connections, damaged enclosures and abnormal heat. Report and isolate all electrical hazards immediately.
dialogue.zh: 重点排查线路老化、接线松动、围栏破损、设备异常发热，所有电气隐患必须立即上报、隔离管控。

dialogue.en: What happens if someone violates electrical safety rules?
dialogue.zh: 如果人员违反电气安全规范，如何处理？

dialogue.en: Any electrical safety violation will trigger immediate stop work, formal investigation and corrective actions. Repeat violations will lead to disciplinary penalties.
dialogue.zh: 所有电气违规行为立即停工整改、溯源调查、落实纠正措施，屡犯将执行纪律追责。

parts.title: Part 5: 培训体系与定期复训

dialogue.en: Who needs to take our electrical safety training?
dialogue.zh: 哪些人员需要参加电气安全培训？

dialogue.en: Qualified electricians need advanced electrical safety training. All other facility staff must at least receive awareness training to recognize electrical hazards.
dialogue.zh: 持证电工需要高阶电气安全培训。其余所有厂务人员至少要接受认知培训，能够识别电气危害。

dialogue.en: How often do we need to renew electrical safety training for our team?
dialogue.zh: 我们团队的电气安全培训多久需要复训一次？

dialogue.en: Electrical safety refresher training shall be conducted at least on annual basis. We also need extra training whenever new equipment or new hazards are introduced.
dialogue.zh: 电气安全培训需每年至少复训一次。当引入新设备、出现新危害时，还要额外培训。
